::: text-center
I graduated from St. Olaf as a biology major with a specific interest in prairie ecology, applied restoration work, land management and developed a love of birds and sedges! Since graduating, I have worked as the Natural Lands Assistant doing just that in the St. Olaf Natural Lands. Through this work, I have also learned to identify hundreds of plants, animals, and fungi in southern Minnesota.
:::

::: text-center
While at St. Olaf, I concentrated in Environmental Studies and Statistics & Data Science -- I continue weave these both into my work and personal life every day. Specifically, I have collected and analyzed ecological data on a variety of topics, including the impacts of *Pedicularis canadensis* on prairie species, Bluebird box viability for species security, and the distribution of White Scroll algae in a coral reef environment. 
:::
